an3.70:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde.
an3.70:1.3: Atha kho Visākhā Migāramātā tad ah' uposathe yena Bhagavā tena upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Visākhaṃ Migāramātaraṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:--
an3.70:1.4: Handa kuto nu tvaṃ Visākhe āgacchasi divādivassā ti.
an3.70:2.5: Seyyathāpi Visākhe gopālako sāyaṇhasamayaṃ sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyādetvā iti paṭisañcikkhati:--
an3.70:2.6: ajja kho gāvo amusmiñ ca amusmiñ ca padese cariṃsu amusmiñ ca amusmiñ ca padese pāniyāni apaṃsu,
an3.70:2.7: sve dāni gāvo amusmiñ ca amusmiñ ca padese carissanti amusmiñ ca amusmiñ ca padese pāniyāni pivissantī ti. Evam
an3.70:2.8: eva kho Visākhe idh' ekacco uposathiko iti paṭisañcikkhati:--
an3.70:2.9: ahaṃ khvajja idañ c' idañ ca khādaniyaṃ khādiṃ idañ c' idañ ca bhojaniyaṃ bhuñjiṃ,
an3.70:2.10: sve dānāhaṃ idañ c' idañ ca khādaniyaṃ khādissāmi idañ c' idañ ca bhojaniyaṃ bhuñjissāmī ti.
an3.70:2.11: So tena lobhena abhijjhāsahagatena cetasā divasaṃ atināmeti.
an3.70:2.13: Evaṃ upavuttho kho Visākhe gopālakūposatho na mahapphalo hoti na mahānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro. 3.
an3.70:3.4: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa ye puratthimāya disāya pāṇā paraṃ yojanasataṃ tesu daṇḍaṃ nikkhipāhi,
an3.70:3.5: ye pacchimāya disāya pāṇā paraṃ yojanasataṃ tesu daṇḍaṃ nikkhipāhi,
an3.70:3.6: ye uttarāya disāya pāṇā paraṃ yojanasataṃ tesu daṇḍaṃ nikkhipāhi,
an3.70:3.7: ye dakkhiṇāya disāya pāṇā paraṃ yojanasataṃ tesu daṇḍaṃ nikkhipāhī ti.
an3.70:3.8: Iti ekaccānaṃ pāṇānaṃ anuddayāya anukampāya samādapenti. Ekaccānaṃ pāṇānaṃ nānuddayāya na anukampāya samādapenti.
an3.70:3.9: Te tadah' uposathe sāvakaṃ evaṃ samādapenti:--
an3.70:3.10: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa sabbacelāni nikkhipitvā evaṃ vadehi --
an3.70:3.11: nāhaṃ kvaci kassaci kiñcanaṃ tasmiṃ, na ca mama kvaci kassaci kiñcanaṃ n' atthī ti.
an3.70:3.24: Iti yasmiṃ samaye sacce samādapetabbā musāvāde tasmiṃ samaye samādapenti.
an3.70:3.26: So tassā rattiyā accayena te bhoge adinnaṃ yeva paribhuñjati.
an3.70:3.29: evaṃ upavuttho kho Visākhe Nigaṇṭhūposatho na mahapphalo hoti na mahānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro. 4.
an3.70:4.2: Upakkiliṭṭhassa Visākhe cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:4.3: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:4.5: iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ Buddho Bhagavā ti.
an3.70:4.6: Tassa Tathāgataṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti, seyyathāpi Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa sīsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:5.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa sīsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:5.2: Kakkañ ca paṭicca mattikañ ca paṭicca udakañ ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca, evaṃ kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa sīsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:5.3: Evam eva kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:6.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:6.3: iti pi so Bhagavā . . . pe . . . satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā ti.
an3.70:6.4: Tassa Tathāgataṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:6.6: ariyasāvako brahmūposathaṃ upavasati Brahmunā saddhiṃ saṃvasati Brahmañ c' assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:6.7: Evaṃ kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti. 5.
an3.70:7.1: Upakkiliṭṭhassa Visākhe cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:7.2: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:7.4: svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī ti.
an3.70:7.5: Tassa dhammaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti, seyyathāpi Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa kāyassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:8.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa kāyassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:8.2: Sottiñ ca paṭicca cuṇṇañ ca paṭicca udakañ ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca.
an3.70:8.3: Evaṃ kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa kāyassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:8.4: Evam eva kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:9.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:9.3: svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo . . . pe (6) . . . paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī ti.
an3.70:9.4: Tassa dhammaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:9.5: Ayaṃ vuccati Visākhe ariyasāvako dhammūposathaṃ upavasati dhammena saddhiṃ saṃvasati dhammañ c' assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:9.6: Evaṃ kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti. 6.
an3.70:10.1: Upakkiliṭṭhassa Visākhe cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:10.2: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:10.4: supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ujupaṭipanno . . . pe . . . ñāyapaṭipanno . . . pe . . . sāmīcipaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇiyyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti.
an3.70:10.5: Tassa saṅghaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti, seyyathāpi Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa vatthassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:11.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa vatthassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:11.2: Ūsañ ca paṭicca khārañ ca paṭicca gomayañ ca paṭicca udakañ ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca.
an3.70:11.3: Evaṃ kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa vatthassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:11.4: Evam eva kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:12.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:12.3: supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti.
an3.70:12.4: Tassa saṅghaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:12.5: Ayaṃ vuccati Visākhe ariyasāvako saṅghūposathaṃ upavasati saṅghena saddhiṃ saṃvasati saṅghañ c' assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:12.6: Evaṃ kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti. 7.
an3.70:13.1: Upakkiliṭṭhassa Visākhe cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:13.2: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:13.3: Idha Visākhe ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati -- akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhi-saṃvattanikāni.
an3.70:13.4: Tassa sīlaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti, seyyathāpi Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa ādāsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:14.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa ādāsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:14.2: Telañ ca paṭicca chārikañ ca paṭicca vālaṇḍukañ ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca.
an3.70:14.3: Evaṃ kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa ādāsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:14.4: Evam eva kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:15.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:15.2: Idha Visākhe ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati -- akhaṇḍāni . . . pe . . . samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
an3.70:15.3: Tassa sīlaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati . . . pe . . . pahīyanti.
an3.70:15.4: Ayaṃ vuccati Visākhe ariyasāvako sīlūposathaṃ upavasati sīlena saddhiṃ saṃvasati sīlañ c' assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:15.5: Evaṃ kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti. 8.
an3.70:16.1: Upakkiliṭṭhassa Visākhe cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:16.2: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:16.4: santi devā Cātummahārājikā, santi devā Tāvatiṃsā, santi devā Yāmā, santi devā Tusitā, santi devā Nimmānaratino, santi devā Paranimmitavasavattino, santi devā Brahmakāyikā, santi devā tatuttariṃ.
an3.70:16.5: Yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatth' uppannā mayham pi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati,
an3.70:16.6: yathārūpena sīlena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatth' uppannā mayham pi tathārūpaṃ sīlaṃ saṃvijjati,
an3.70:16.7: yathārūpena sutena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatth' uppannā mayham pi tathārūpaṃ sutaṃ saṃvijjati,
an3.70:16.8: yathārūpena cāgena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatth' uppannā mayham pi tathārūpo cāgo saṃvijjati,
an3.70:16.9: yathārūpāya paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatth' uppannā mayham pi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī ti.
an3.70:16.10: Tassa attano ca tāsañ ca devatānaṃ saddhañ ca sīlañ ca sutañ ca cāgañ ca paññañ ca anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti, seyyathāpi Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa jātarūpassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:17.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa jātarūpassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:17.2: Ukkañ ca paṭicca loṇañ ca paṭicca gerukañ ca paṭicca nāḷikañ ca paṭicca saṇḍāsañ ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca.
an3.70:17.3: Evaṃ kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa jātarūpassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:17.4: Evam eva kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:18.1: Kathañca Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
an3.70:18.3: santi devā Cātummahārājikā, santi devā Tāvatiṃsā . . . pe . . . santi devā tatuttariṃ.
an3.70:18.4: Yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatth' uppannā mayham pi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati,
an3.70:18.8: paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatth' uppannā mayham pi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī ti.
an3.70:18.9: Tassa attano tāsañ ca devatānaṃ saddhañ ca sīlañ ca sutañ ca cāgañ ca paññañ ca anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:18.10: Ayaṃ vuccati ariyasāvako devatūposathaṃ upavasati devatāhi saddhiṃ saṃvasati, devatā c' assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:18.11: Evaṃ kho Visākhe upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti. 9.
an3.70:19.1: Sa kho so Visākhe ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
an3.70:19.2: -yāvajīvaṃ arahanto pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā nihitadaṇḍā nihitasatthā lajjī dayāpannā sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampino viharanti,
an3.70:19.3: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharāmi.
an3.70:19.4: Iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati. 10.
an3.70:20.1: Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭiviratā dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharanti,
an3.70:20.2: aham p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharāmi.
an3.70:20.3: Iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati. 11.
an3.70:21.1: Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ārācārī viratā methunā gāmadhammā,
an3.70:21.2: aham p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
an3.70:21.3: Iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati. 12.
an3.70:22.1: Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭiviratā saccavādī saccasandhā thetā paccayikā avisaṃvādakā lokassa,
an3.70:22.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
an3.70:22.3: Iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati. 13.
an3.70:23.1: Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānaṃ pahāya surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā,
an3.70:23.2: ahaṃ pi ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānaṃ pahāya surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato
an3.70:23.3: viharāmi. Iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati. 14.
an3.70:24.1: Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto ekabhattikā rattūparatā viratā vikālabhojanā,
an3.70:24.2: aham p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ ekabhattiko rattūparato virato vikālabhojanā.
an3.70:24.3: Iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati. 15.
an3.70:25.2: aham p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ naccagītavāditavisūkadassanāmālāgandhavilepanadhāraṇamaṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānā paṭivirato.
an3.70:25.3: Iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati. 16.
an3.70:26.1: Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto uccāsayana-mahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭiviratā nīcaseyyaṃ kappenti mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā,
an3.70:26.2: aham p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭivirato nīcaseyyaṃ kappemi mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā.
an3.70:26.3: Iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī ti.
an3.70:27.2: evaṃ upavuttho kho Visākhe ariyūposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro. 17.
an3.70:28.1: Kīva mahapphalo hoti, kīva mahānisaṃso, kīva mahājutiko, kīva mahāvipphāro?
an3.70:28.2: Seyyathāpi Visākhe yo imesaṃ soḷasannaṃ mahājanapadānaṃ pahūtamahāsattaratanānaṃ issarādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kareyya, seyyathīdaṃ
an3.70:28.3: Aṅgānaṃ Magadhānaṃ Kāsīnaṃ Kosalānaṃ Vajjīnaṃ Mallānaṃ Cetīnaṃ Vaṅgānaṃ Kurūnaṃ Pañcālāṇaṃ Macchānaṃ Surasenānaṃ Assakānaṃ Avantīnaṃ Gandhārānaṃ Kambojānaṃ, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatassa uposathassa ekaṃ kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an3.70:28.5: Kapaṇaṃ Visākhe mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya. 18.
an3.70:29.1: Yāni Visākhe mānusakāni paññāsa vassāni Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an3.70:29.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni pañca vassa-satāni Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an3.70:29.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Visākhe vijjati yaṃ idh' ekacco itthī vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjeyya.
an3.70:29.6: Idaṃ kho pan' etam Visākhe sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an3.70:29.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya. 19.
an3.70:30.1: Yaṃ Visākhe mānusakaṃ vassasataṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo
an3.70:30.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an3.70:30.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Visākhe vijjati yaṃ idh' ekacco itthī vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjeyya.
an3.70:30.6: Idaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Visākhe sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an3.70:30.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya. 20.
